result.topic_en: Riemann sets up a potential P for a system of mass points with pairwise central forces and derives a minimum condition (Gauss's principle of least constraint) involving the squared accelerations and P at time t+dt.
result.transcription:
$m_\iota$ $m_{\iota'}$ $m_\iota m_{\iota'} f_{\iota,\iota'}(r_{\iota,\iota'})$ $F_{\iota,\iota'}(r)$ $F'_{\iota,\iota'}(r) = -f_{\iota,\iota'}(r)$
$P = \sum \sum m_\iota m_{\iota'} [-f-] F_{\iota,\iota'}(r_{\iota,\iota'})$ $r_{\iota,\iota'}^2 = (x_\iota - x_{\iota'})^2 + (y_\iota - y_{\iota'})^2 + (z_\iota - z_{\iota'})^2$
$\frac{\partial P}{\partial x_\iota} = X_\iota$
$\sum m\left(\left(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{d^2y}{dt^2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{d^2z}{dt^2}\right)^2\right) - 2\sum\left(X\frac{d^2x}{dt^2} + Y\frac{d^2y}{dt^2} + Z\frac{d^2z}{dt^2}\right) = \text{Min.}$
$- 2\sum_\iota\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial x_\iota}\frac{d^2x_\iota}{dt^2} + \frac{\partial P}{\partial y_\iota}\frac{d^2y_\iota}{dt^2} + \frac{\partial P}{\partial z_\iota}\frac{d^2z_\iota}{dt^2}\right)$
$\sum m\left(\left(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{d^2y}{dt^2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{d^2z}{dt^2}\right)^2\right) - 2\frac{\partial^2 P}{\partial t^2} = \text{Min.}$ $P_{t+dt} = P + \frac{\partial P}{\partial t}dt + \frac{\partial^2 P}{\partial t^2}\frac{dt^2}{2} + \dots$
$\sum m\left[\left(d\frac{dx}{dt}\right)^2 + \left(d\frac{dy}{dt}\right)^2 + \left(d\frac{dz}{dt}\right)^2\right] - 4 P_{t+dt} = \text{Min.}$

methods.what: Potential function for pairwise central forces between mass points, with force law as negative derivative
Force components as partial derivatives of the potential
Gauss's principle of least constraint in expanded form
Taylor expansion of P in time
Reformulation of the minimum principle using P at time t+dt
